# Machine-source transfer ledger

These are direct source inspections, not new Lean compilation or certification. A machine optimization counts toward the exponent only when its complete child-rank profile and physical inventory improve.

## Old-state operand capture: constructed and tested

OpenAI math, `lean/OAI/Computability/WeisfeilerLeman/RAMInstruction.lean`, defines `WLTime.SparseRAM.execute`: a load evaluates its address/read from the old configuration and only then updates the destination register. The theorem `execute_forget` states

    A.execute I (forget A n C) = forget A n (execute I C).

`SparseStore.lean`, theorem `WLTime.WordMemory.read_prepend`, states that a prepended address/value pair implements exactly `Function.update` of the abstract memory. This makes the distinction between an old value and its overwritten successor explicit.

The P18 source `Mathproof/Meta/Problem18IMPAssignments20261002.lean`, `run_assignments`, proves a static assignment sequence correct from original-environment right-hand-side values under `Independent xs`; `run_framed` adds preservation of untouched variables, arrays and external tapes. This is a sufficient independence hypothesis, not permission to merge aliased live registers. `Problem18P351PairSnapshot20261003.lean`, theorem `run`, gives an exact snapshot into a separate bank while preserving every other array and external tape.

Concrete transfer: PR507 captures both pair intermediates after their two-shear basis change. We implemented a triangular snapshot between the two shears: capture the new pair sum and the still-unmodified second operand. The resulting pair basis remains invertible; the later own-tetrad decoder is recomputed exactly. Three variants change one or both tetrad parities. All pass clean scalar algebra; after retiming and exact rational kernel construction, the best snapshot-even candidate has88 pivots and an improved full supplier compared with the simple84-pivot composition. It nevertheless loses to the separately found92-pivot word. Therefore old-state capture is a real tested mechanism but is not counted as an ingredient of the selected92-pivot construction.

## Actual first-read frontier: bounded test

The exact frame immediately before the first observer, rather than the pre-retiming source layout, determines which incoming cancellation subspaces are legal. We recomputed these first-read frontiers from the emitted retimed body and reran a bounded native C++ response search. A valid89-pivot word resulted, but its full supplier price was below the92-pivot word. No gain from this representation is counted in the winner.

## Ambient frame preservation

OpenAI math, `WLIdentification/WordCommands.lean`, theorem `StackModel.Command.Exec.rename`, transports execution through an injective register renaming while preserving every ambient location outside the image. This is the correct local rule for reusing a physical region whose other live contents must survive. It requires injectivity on simultaneously live registers; it does not by itself justify identifying two live helpers or erasing their dirty state.

The parent/complex lane uses this distinction while testing lifetime-based coalescing of own-helper storage with retired factory rows. The actual paid transitions and arbitrary-dirt restoration must be constructed before claiming an exponent gain. A literal rank4-to-rank3 descent adds total variation; dropping a helper count alone is not a price argument.

## Selected fallback and honest attribution

The selected fallback has92 kernel pivots with profile

    1:2539, 2:160, 3:530, 4:88, 5:298, 6:68, 7:1, 8:17

and residual inventory18 width7,154 width8,388 width9. It combines PR507's changed factory with the prior coordinated rank2 gauges, public frame retiming, asynchronous whole-owner packing, and an improved response-basis selection. The92-pivot improvement is an application of our existing algebraic response selector; it is not relabeled as one of three new machine techniques. Its exact local scalar audit passes all800 columns in both orientations and92 omission controls. The parent's complete physical and arithmetic replay remains the authority for the final exponent.
